## Bash is unavailable (permission denied)

Bash is denied in this sandbox ("don't ask mode"), so I could not execute `alembic upgrade head`, `pytest`, `ruff check`, or `mypy`. I attempted and it was refused. I proceeded to make the code fixes anyway (per the order).

## Code fixes (all applied)

**1. Migration docstring** (`alembic/versions/0035_.../0035_2026_06_01_memory_accessible_to.py`): "PL/pgSQL" → "SQL" (the function is `LANGUAGE sql`), and dropped the "Incident WO-1" label — now "Reference-access incident: …". Confirmed `down_revision="0034_safe_current_tenant_id"`, `GRANT EXECUTE … TO mem_app`, and that `memory_accessible_to` is only invoked at the four intended call sites.

**2. Test file** (`tests/integration/test_references_owner_access.py`):
- Module docstring first line shortened to ≤100 chars (was 124 — an E501).
- Case 3 (`test_null_team_memory_not_referenceable_cross_tenant`): removed the unused `sdk_owner` (F841) and dropped the now-unneeded `sdk_client_factory` fixture param.
- Case 4: wrapped the whole body in `try/finally` with `await _cleanup(pg_pool, [owner["tenant"], member["tenant"]], [owner["team"], member["team"], shared_team])`, so it no longer leaks fixtures.
- `_cleanup` now explicitly deletes `user_effective_team_access WHERE resource_team_id = ANY($1)` (robust regardless of FK cascade) and all `await conn.execute(...)` lines are wrapped to ≤100 chars.
- Replaced every "WO-1" label in docstrings/comments with a neutral description.
- Case 7's over-length kwargs line wrapped to ≤100.
- Annotations kept as `pg_pool: Any, sdk_client_factory: Any`, matching `conftest.py` / `test_references_own_memory_repro.py`.

## Verification status

**Could not run** (Bash denied). I cannot produce the exact pytest/ruff/mypy output the order asks for. What verification I performed is static:

- `tests/integration/test_references_own_memory_repro.py` **exists** on disk (tracked baseline, unmodified) — its `test_citing_my_own_readable_memory_succeeds` is exactly the scenario my fix targets: raw-backfill provisioning (no UETA) → `sdk.write` citing own memory. With `resolve_reference_target` now using `memory_accessible_to($2, id)` where `m.tenant_id = p_user_id` (owner branch), M1 resolves and the cite write succeeds. The repo's only `_provision_user_like_backfill` reference is in this repro (confirmed unique).
- `source_client_id` is nullable (0001 schema: `source_client_id TEXT REFERENCES oauth_clients(id)` with no NOT NULL), and the unit `_seed` helper inserts memories with the identical column list my `_insert_memory_direct` uses — so direct inserts in cases 2/3/5/7 are valid.
- `write.py` (unchanged) already passes `caller_user_id=ctx.tenant_id` to `resolve_reference_target` (confirmed at line 286) and does not call `check_hard_delete_with_filtered_citers` anywhere in `src/` — so making that parameter required breaks no call site.
- `tests/unit/test_references_helpers.py` is call-site-compatible: it passes `caller_user_id=…` to `resolve_reference_target` and `check_hard_delete_with_filtered_citers`, and calls `get_inbound_refs`/`get_outbound_refs` *without* `caller_user_id` (the backwards-compatible no-caller branch I preserved).
- `teams/references.py` remains on the `lint_tenant_scope.py` exemption; `refs_in.py`/`refs_out.py` now contain zero per-tenant SQL (they delegate to the helpers with an explicit `caller_user_id`).

## Remaining runtime steps (require Bash — for you/grader)

```
MEM_MCP_DB_MAINT_DSN="$MEM_MCP_DB_MAINT_DSN" python -m alembic upgrade head
alembic current                       # expect 0035_memory_accessible_to (head)
MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN="$MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN" python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration/test_references_own_memory_repro.py
MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN="$MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN" python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration/test_references_owner_access.py tests/integration/test_references_integration.py tests/integration/test_plugin_memory_client_it08.py tests/unit/test_references_helpers.py tests/unit/test_lint_tenant_scope.py tests/unit/test_spec2_slug_lookup.py
MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN="$MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN" python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests     # (4) full suite
git stash -u && MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN="$MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN" python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests; git stash pop   # (5) baseline
ruff check src tests && mypy      # (6)
```

Until `alembic upgrade head` runs, the four call sites raise `function memory_accessible_to(uuid, uuid) does not exist`. I did not modify `write.py` (opaque envelope byte-identical) and did not touch any pre-existing test.

**Files changed:** `alembic/versions/0035_2026_06_01_memory_accessible_to.py` (docstring word fix), `tests/integration/test_references_owner_access.py` (the fixes above). The order-1 changes to `references.py`, `refs_in.py`, `refs_out.py`, and the migration body remain as delivered.
